page.layout: One printed page. A single column of running text, with a narrow column of small marginal notes down the right margin, mostly unreadable. Running head at the top. Page number at the top right. Signature at the foot left.

main_text.p: inde Appianus,& exponit varios ac dif-ficiles Romanorum labores exantlatos, dum eniterentur in arcem, in viis pari-ter & domorum tectis planis, in quæ evaserant, contra eos, qui se objicie-bant, depugnantes: describitque gra-phicè plusquàm miserabilem & verè lamentabilem faciem & fragoré ruen-tis Carthaginis, urbis maximæ & paulo antè florentissimæ ac splendidissimæ,& omnis generis casus lugubres, ac varias acerbasque mortes pereuntium homi-num, ut neminem ea legere sine dolore & gemitu posse, qui ferreus non sit, existimem. Scipio certè victor, ut testa-tus est, qui præsens ei adstitit; Polybius, cum cadentem, & ardentem urbem, potentiâ nuper maximis regibus pa-rem, animis audaciaque etiam superio-rem intueretur, lachrumas fudit,& ho-stium tam acerbam fortunam deflevit: recordatusque inconstantiæ & vicif-tudinis rerum humanarum, idem al. quando accidere posse patriæ suæ Ro-mæ metuere se fassus fuit. Quod qu-dem non abs re metuisse animum ejus præsagum, eventus sub Totilâ Gotthorum rege tandem probavit. Sed Scipio, ut eo revertar, cum armatis in Byrsa post continuos sex dierum noctiumque labores per summa pericula cum pe[illegible, ~4 letters] venisse

page.notes: Right margin: small marginal notes and reference marks (such as =€ and similar signs) run down the whole height of the margin. They are overprinted or cut off and cannot be read, so they are not transcribed. The last text line is partly covered by a marginal mark, which is why "pe" is followed by an illegible gap. "venisse" is partly obscured and is read with some doubt. The text is read as one paragraph continuing from the previous page; no paragraph indent is visible. The running head reads "REIP. CARTHAGINIENSIVM." with the printed V for the vowel u, normalised to U per rule 5. The page number "53" is read from a worn figure at the top right and may be doubtful.
